minimum_contract_before_source: A separate value-only suppression candidate freezes original physical Pencil serial, window identity, original scaled contact point and completed exposed-canvas presentation identity before super physical Begin; ring/HUD/native-navigation priority remains exact.

Immediately before recognized Begin can arm omission, resolve current native window/area/region from live membership and validate that frozen presentation through a narrow callback-free bridge or a proven complete invalidation scheme. No old pointer dereference, Python/RNA poll, draw or arbitrary native operator admission.

Any refusal/missing/unknown/stale/unproved state keeps legacy ordinary events. A-to-B-to-A before threshold must not re-admit an old candidate through equal current values; the concrete epoch/retirement path remains to be designed and proved.

Suppression data must stay separate from PencilPaintContact: tagging paint changes producer/WM shared-pointer ownership, begin admission and cancelled-terminal behavior. Reusing paint ownership would violate the ordinary cursor/down/up contract.

The only allowed event-list change is omission of its explicitly paired PAN on the admitted original precision stream. Preserve recognized coordinates, cursor/down/up count/order, translation-cache updates, tablet snapshots, modifiers, flags and terminal semantics. No ToolManipulation, forced Knife invocation, pending-DOWN prediction or new terminal lease.

Before admitting a broad tool-independent canvas policy, prove native navigation/tool-widget paths retain their behavior; generic geometry alone does not establish editing-versus-navigation semantics. Tool transitions relevant to that classification must invalidate the original receipt.
